example_sentences_in_bangla: এটা চোখের ভুল, আসলে কোনো ছায়া নেই।
দূর থেকে দেখে মনে হয়েছে চোখের ভুল।
example_sentences_in_english: It was just an optical illusion; there was no shadow.
From afar, it seemed like a trick of the eye.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali to describe visual misperceptions without deeper historical or religious connotations.
